annual_fee.note: New accounts and applicable renewals from 2024-02-01; the preceding benefit refresh began 2023-10-03.

benefits.name: Flexible Business credit
benefits.enrollment_how: Enroll the benefit in the Amex account.
benefits.qualifying: One $20 monthly allowance shared across U.S. Grubhub, office-supply stores and qualifying small-parcel shipping bought directly at UPS.com.
benefits.note: UPS.com replaced FedEx on 2026-10-01; older reviews still list FedEx. The UPS Store and other excluded UPS services are not the same as direct UPS.com parcel shipping.

benefits.name: ChatGPT Business credit
benefits.enrollment_how: Enroll the benefit in the Amex account.
benefits.qualifying: Eligible U.S. ChatGPT Business subscription purchases; the subscription renews automatically.
benefits.note: Amex documented this benefit on 2026-06-05; its first effective date was not found. Older annual-credit totals of $395 leave it out. Description verified on a real statement credit (2026-09-09).

benefits.name: Squarespace credit
benefits.enrollment_how: Enroll the benefit in the Amex account.
benefits.qualifying: Eligible U.S. purchases made directly with Squarespace.
benefits.note: Started 2025-10-23 (Doctor of Credit, The Points Guy and AwardWallet agree; the 2026-08-21 date in earlier research was an article update). Purchases directly with Squarespace (squarespace.com, acuityscheduling.com). Description verified on a real statement credit (2026-07-21).

benefits.name: Walmart+ credit
benefits.enrollment_how: Join Walmart+ and pay the membership with the card; a separate Amex activation was not found.
benefits.qualifying: One monthly Walmart+ membership charge; annual plans and Plus Ups are excluded.
benefits.note: The allowance is $12.95 a month plus applicable tax, or $155.40 a year before tax; the '$155 Walmart+ credit' wording in Amex marketing is a rounded figure.

benefits.name: The Hotel Collection property credit
benefits.enrollment_how: Book through Amex Travel; minimum two consecutive nights.
benefits.qualifying: Property-designated incidentals at participating hotels; room benefits depend on availability.

benefits.name: Amex Venue Collection concessions
benefits.enrollment_how: Enroll one eligible Amex card per Card Member.
benefits.qualifying: 10% back on food and drink at participating stadium and arena concessions; tickets, parking and merchandise excluded.
benefits.note: One allowance per Card Member across all enrolled Amex cards.

thresholds.unlocks: 4x in the two highest-spend eligible categories each billing cycle, up to this combined amount, then 1x.
